legal_gdpr_transfer_mechanism: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) + EU data residency (Frankfurt) pinning

legal_risks.risk: Subprocessor change notice period (30 days) may be insufficient for Brightline's internal legal review cycle
legal_risks.mitigation: Negotiate 60-day notice or right to object clause; require written DPA amendment before subprocessor activation

legal_risks.risk: Zoho DPA v HubSpot DPA — Zoho's standard DPA is largely self-certified; HubSpot provides Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) as additional transfer mechanism
legal_risks.mitigation: Require Zoho to countersign EU SCCs (2021 version) before go-live; verify Zoho EU Ltd as contracting entity, not US parent

legal_risks.risk: Data subject rights fulfilment SLA absent from standard Zoho contract — GDPR Art.12 requires response within 1 month
legal_risks.mitigation: Add contractual obligation on Zoho to support DSR (access, erasure, portability) within 72h of Brightline's forwarded request

legal_risks.risk: Liability cap in Zoho standard terms typically limited to 12 months' fees (~EUR 18,240) — may be inadequate for GDPR supervisory fines (up to 4% global turnover)
legal_risks.mitigation: Negotiate mutual liability cap of at minimum EUR 50,000 for data-processing breaches; retain right to seek injunctive relief uncapped

legal_risks.risk: Termination data-return window (30-day export right confirmed) may not cover backups — residual data in Zoho's disaster-recovery copies
legal_risks.mitigation: Add clause requiring Zoho to certify deletion of all backup copies within 90 days of contract termination and provide written confirmation
